task: Review this fictional testimonial for use on a product website. Identify the unsupported claims and explain what evidence would be needed to use the testimonial accurately.
input: TaskHaven changed everything for our team. We cut our project completion time in half within three weeks.

facts.text: The testimonial is attributed to an unnamed team.
The supplied packet contains no project-completion time data for any customer.
The supplied packet contains no attribution identifying the reviewer's company or role.

forbidden_additions: An invented project-completion figure to replace the claim.
A claim that the stated figure is plausible or within a typical range.
preserve: The identification of missing evidence: time-data and customer attribution.
The distinction between a supported and an unsupported customer claim.
